seo.h1: Flights from Ho Chi Minh City to Singapore
seo.intro: The Ho Chi Minh City to Singapore air corridor is one of Southeast Asia busiest business and leisure routes, spanning roughly 1,090 km with average flight times under two hours.
seo.title: Ho Chi Minh City to Singapore Flights: Direct Routes & Schedules | Tripways
seo.subheadline: Compare daily nonstop flights between SGN and SIN from top airlines
seo.meta_description: Find all nonstop flights from Ho Chi Minh City (SGN) to Singapore Changi (SIN). Compare flight schedules, prices, airlines, and airport transit info.

faqs.answer: A direct flight from Tan Son Nhat Airport (SGN) to Singapore Changi (SIN) takes approximately 2 hours and 5 minutes.
faqs.question: How long is the flight from Ho Chi Minh City to Singapore?

faqs.answer: Vietnamese passport holders are eligible for visa-free entry to Singapore for stays up to 30 days. An electronic SG Arrival Card submission is mandatory.
faqs.question: Do I need a visa to travel from Vietnam to Singapore?

faqs.answer: Singapore Airlines and Scoot generally arrive at Terminal 1, 2, or 3, while Vietjet Air typically operates from Terminal 4.
faqs.question: Which terminal does the flight land at in Singapore?

travel_facts.body: Direct nonstop flights take roughly 2 hours to 2 hours 15 minutes.
travel_facts.title: Flight Time

travel_facts.body: The flight distance from Tan Son Nhat (SGN) to Singapore Changi (SIN) is approximately 1,090 km (677 miles).
travel_facts.title: Route Distance

travel_facts.body: There are multiple daily departures operated by full-service and low-cost carriers.
travel_facts.title: Flight Frequency

editorial_sections.body: Singapore Airlines and Vietnam Airlines offer premium full-service experiences including meals and checked luggage. Budget travelers can choose Scoot or Vietjet Air for lower base fares.
editorial_sections.heading: Airlines Flying Between SGN and SIN

editorial_sections.body: Singapore Changi Airport features four interconnected terminals. All foreign visitors must submit the electronic SG Arrival Card (SGAC) within 3 days prior to arrival.
editorial_sections.heading: Arriving at Singapore Changi (SIN)
